# session-exchange

auth.sessionExchangeHandlers — app-defined login methods (ID token, email code) that the framework mints into a session.

## README

# Sample: Session Exchange

**I want my own login method (Apple/Google ID token, email link) without rebuilding cookies, JWTs and rate limits.**

## What this sample shows

An anonymous write handler verifies an identity and returns `{ kind: "auth-session", session }`. The app lists it under `auth.sessionExchangeHandlers`; `POST /api/auth/session-exchange` runs it and mints the session like `/auth/login` (token, cookies). The rate limit counts per IP and method and is not reset on success, because the route cannot tell whose code was right. By default it reuses the login limiter; set `auth.sessionExchangeRateLimit` to a larger limiter, or `null` to turn it off (for example when the methods carry signed tokens).

## What to copy into your app

```ts illustration
auth: {
  membershipQuery: "tenant:query:memberships",
  loginHandler: "auth-email-password:write:login",
  sessionExchangeHandlers: { code: "demo-exchange:write:code" },
},
```

The client calls `POST /api/auth/session-exchange` with `{ method: "code", payload: { ... } }`.

## Design rules

1. **Only listed handlers can issue a session.** The route resolves `method` against the map (own keys only); the handler QN never comes from the client.
2. **The handler owns verification.** The demo compares a fixed code; a real handler verifies the ID token signature and audience first, then calls `sessionForVerifiedUser(ctx, { email })` (or `{ userId }`) for the login gates: account status, membership choice, claims. A lookup by email only issues a session for a verified address (otherwise a pre-registered attacker account would be taken over by the victim), a lookup by `userId` trusts your own identity link. There is no password or lockout gate, so accept only credentials that cannot be guessed: a signed ID token or a long random one-time token. A short code (six digits by mail) needs its own attempt counter per identity in the handler; the route only knows the IP, and a per-IP bucket does not stop a distributed guess. There is no MFA gate: boot aborts when `auth-mfa` is mounted together with `sessionExchangeHandlers`.
3. **Anything but `auth-session` is rejected.** An MFA challenge or foreign result yields 500 and no cookie.
4. **Errors map like login.** `details.reason` goes through `loginErrorStatusMap`.
5. **Grant SYSTEM to the one handler, hide it from agents.** `escapeHatch: { grants: ["systemIdentity"] }` on the exchange handler, not `r.systemScope()` on the feature, and `agent: { expose: false }` because the payload is a credential.

## Tests

- **End-to-end over HTTP:** exchange returns a token that authenticates a query
- **Wrong code:** 401 via `invalid_credentials`
- **Restricted user:** no session
- **Unknown method:** 400

```ts
// Session Exchange Sample — Integration Test
//
// Real HTTP + DB: an app-defined exchange handler is listed under
// auth.sessionExchangeHandlers and the framework route mints the session.

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { AuthErrors, hashPassword } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/auth-email-password";
import {
  configValuesTable,
  createConfigFeature,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/config";
import {
  createTenantFeature,
  tenantEntity,
  tenantMembershipsTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant";
import { seedTenantMembership } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant/seeding";
import {
  createUserFeature,
  USER_STATUS,
  UserHandlers,
  userEntity,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/user";
import { updateUserViaEventStore } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/user/testing";
import type { TenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { TestUsers, testTenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import {
  setupTestStack,
  type TestStack,
  unsafeCreateEntityTable,
  unsafePushTables,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import {
  DEMO_EXCHANGE_CODE,
  DEMO_EXCHANGE_QN,
  demoExchangeFeature,
  INVALID_CREDENTIALS_REASON,
} from "../feature";

const TENANT: TenantId = testTenantId(1);
const EMAIL = "exchange@example.com";

let stack: TestStack;

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({
    features: [
      createConfigFeature(),
      createUserFeature(),
      createTenantFeature(),
      demoExchangeFeature,
    ],
    authConfig: {
      membershipQuery: "tenant:query:memberships",
      sessionExchangeHandlers: { code: DEMO_EXCHANGE_QN },
      loginErrorStatusMap: { [INVALID_CREDENTIALS_REASON]: 401 },
      loginRateLimit: null,
    },
  });

  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, userEntity);
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, tenantEntity);
  await unsafePushTables(stack.db, { configValuesTable, tenantMembershipsTable });

  await createMember(EMAIL, { verified: true });
});

async function createMember(email: string, opts: { verified: boolean }): Promise<string> {
  const created = await stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
    UserHandlers.create,
    {
      email,
      passwordHash: await hashPassword("super-long-password"),
      displayName: "Exchange",
    },
    TestUsers.systemAdmin,
  );
  await seedTenantMembership(stack.db, { userId: created.id, tenantId: TENANT, roles: ["User"] });
  if (opts.verified) {
    await updateUserViaEventStore(stack.db, created.id, { emailVerified: true });
  }
  return created.id;
}

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

function exchange(body: unknown): Promise<Response> {
  return stack.http.raw("POST", "/api/auth/session-exchange", body);
}

describe("session-exchange sample wiring", () => {
  test("valid code mints a token that authenticates a query", async () => {
    const res = await exchange({
      method: "code",
      payload: { email: EMAIL, code: DEMO_EXCHANGE_CODE },
    });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const { token } = (await res.json()) as { token: string };
    expect(token.length).toBeGreaterThan(20);

    const me = await stack.http.raw(
      "POST",
      "/api/query",
      { type: "user:query:user:me", payload: {} },
      { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    );
    expect(me.status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("wrong code is 401 via invalid_credentials", async () => {
    const res = await exchange({ method: "code", payload: { email: EMAIL, code: "000000" } });
    expect(res.status).toBe(401);
  });

  test("a restricted user gets no session", async () => {
    const restrictedId = await createMember("restricted@example.com", { verified: true });
    await updateUserViaEventStore(stack.db, restrictedId, { status: USER_STATUS.Restricted });

    const res = await exchange({
      method: "code",
      payload: { email: "restricted@example.com", code: DEMO_EXCHANGE_CODE },
    });
    expect(res.status).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(400);
    expect(res.headers.getSetCookie()).toEqual([]);
    expect(((await res.json()) as { token?: string }).token).toBeUndefined();
  });

  test("an unverified email gets no session", async () => {
    await createMember("unverified@example.com", { verified: false });
    const res = await exchange({
      method: "code",
      payload: { email: "unverified@example.com", code: DEMO_EXCHANGE_CODE },
    });
    expect(res.status).toBe(422);
    expect(res.headers.getSetCookie()).toEqual([]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(await res.json())).toContain(AuthErrors.emailNotVerified);
  });

  test("unknown method is 400", async () => {
    const res = await exchange({ method: "other", payload: {} });
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// Session Exchange Sample
//
// An app-defined login method: an anonymous write handler verifies an identity
// and returns { kind: "auth-session", session }; the framework route mints the
// session (token, cookies, rate limit) exactly like /auth/login.
//
// What to copy into your own app:
//
//   auth: {
//     membershipQuery: "tenant:query:memberships",
//     sessionExchangeHandlers: { code: "demo-exchange:write:code" },
//   },
//
// Only handlers listed in sessionExchangeHandlers can cause a session to be
// issued, so a handler that merely returns a session-shaped object elsewhere
// stays harmless. The demo code check stands in for verifying an ID token;
// sessionForVerifiedUser then runs the login gates after the identity proof
// (account status, membership choice, claims).

import { sessionForVerifiedUser } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/auth-email-password";
import { defineFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { UnprocessableError, writeFailure } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/errors";
import { z } from "zod";

export const DEMO_EXCHANGE_CODE = "246810";
export const DEMO_EXCHANGE_QN = "demo-exchange:write:code";
export const INVALID_CREDENTIALS_REASON = "invalid_credentials";

export const demoExchangeFeature = defineFeature("demo-exchange", (r) => {
  r.requires({ features: ["user", "tenant"] });

  r.writeHandler({
    name: "code",
    schema: z.object({ email: z.email(), code: z.string().min(1) }),
    access: { roles: ["anonymous"] },
    escapeHatch: {
      grants: ["systemIdentity"],
      reason:
        "Unauthenticated exchange has no caller identity yet — sessionForVerifiedUser looks up the user and resolves the membership as SYSTEM before a session exists.",
    },
    // The payload carries a credential (code or ID token) that must never enter an LLM transcript.
    agent: { expose: false },
    handler: async (event, ctx) => {
      if (event.payload.code !== DEMO_EXCHANGE_CODE) {
        return writeFailure(
          new UnprocessableError(INVALID_CREDENTIALS_REASON, {
            i18nKey: "demo-exchange.errors.invalidCredentials",
          }),
        );
      }
      return sessionForVerifiedUser(ctx, { email: event.payload.email });
    },
  });
});
```
